title: Autonomous AI Interview System
subtitle: Core AI Engineering Project
description: Full-scale automated mock interview platform featuring real-time speech-to-text, dynamic contextual question adaptation, video/audio stream processing, and multi-metric candidate assessment.

caseStudy.architecture: Engineered an asynchronous media pipeline interfacing browser WebRTC streams with Whisper STT and contextual LLM prompting. Utilized streaming token responses to reduce latency from 3.2s to sub-450ms for realistic dialog pacing.
caseStudy.breakthroughs: Implemented adaptive candidate evaluation matrices scoring semantic relevance, acoustic confidence intervals, and response cadence in real time.

title: Zwapy Career & Skill Platform
subtitle: Venture Platform Product
description: Integrated career development ecosystem with verified skill badges, dynamic interactive portfolios, and automated enterprise recruitment match engines.

caseStudy.architecture: Constructed an event-driven Supabase backend connected to a Next.js 14 client, supporting dynamic resume parsing, cryptographic badge verification, and role-based matching algorithms.
caseStudy.breakthroughs: Designed interactive portfolio widgets enabling candidates to showcase live project outputs directly to enterprise hiring partners.

title: Parinayam Connect Portal
subtitle: Community Matchmaking Portal
description: Secure matchmaking and community discovery network with end-to-end credential authentication, low-latency filter algorithms, and real-time communication protocols.

caseStudy.architecture: Implemented a multi-tier verification engine with strict row-level security in PostgreSQL. Real-time messaging leverages low-latency WebSocket connection pools with message queuing.
caseStudy.breakthroughs: Developed high-concurrency search indexing with composite filtering across 20+ preference parameters operating at sub-50ms query response times.

title: IoT Smart Water Flow Management
subtitle: Embedded Systems & Hardware IoT
description: Automated fluid metering architecture utilizing ultrasonic sensors to identify anomalies and trigger automatic solenoid shut-offs with real-time cloud telemetry.

caseStudy.architecture: Firmware engineered in C/C++ on low-power microcontrollers capturing ultrasonic pulse-transit metrics. Device feeds telemetry to cloud broker over MQTT/HTTPS for continuous time-series logging.
caseStudy.breakthroughs: Designed edge anomaly detection algorithm running directly on microcontrollers to shut off high-pressure valves within 180 milliseconds of burst detection.
